item_name: Rothco Rechargeable 1000 Lumen Led Headlamp - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Rechargeable 1000 Lumen LED Headlamp provides powerful illumination with three light modes and a tilting head that make it ideal for work, the great outdoors, and more.
description: Rothco’s Rechargeable 1000 Lumen LED Headlamp provides powerful illumination with three light modes and a tilting head that make it ideal for work, the great outdoors, and more. The headlamp features an ultra-bright COB LED lamp with zoom capability to expand or contract the field of light as needed. The headlamp tilts up to 90 degrees to prevent head fatigue and features three light modes: high, low, and strobe. The hunting headlamp is worn via a 3-way head elastic strap which is comfortable on bare heads and compatible with hard hats. The flashlight measures 2.5 inches x 2.5 inches x 1 ¾ inches and is IP4X water-resistant.
